headline: American Express to Cut 5% of Global Workforce
summary: American Express is reducing its global workforce by 5% in an effort to streamline operations and enhance efficiency, CEO Stephen Squeri announced.
why: American Express is one of the world's largest payment and credit networks; head-count reductions signal cost-discipline efforts amid economic headwinds.

impacts.name: American Express Company
impacts.why: Restructuring cuts operating expenses and supports operating profit margins.
